# LOGOS — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 15
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 18-19 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 15

---

**15:1** When Levi had said this, they began to go forth to proclaim and to preach.

---

*Translator's Note (LOGOS):* The gospel ends here — abruptly, without narrative closure on the Peter-Mary dispute. The departure for mission is the answer to the conflict. Some manuscripts include a colophon "The Gospel according to Mary" at this point.
